name: sp_419_Normalized

schema.description: Context Schema for a video player event

autoPictureInPicture.description: A boolean value that is true if the video should enter or leave picture-in-picture mode automatically when changing tab and/or application

disablePictureInPicture.description: The disablePictureInPicture property will hint the user agent to not suggest the picture-in-picture to users or to request it automatically

poster.description: 'poster' HTML attribute, which specifies an image to show while no video data is available

videoHeight.description: A value indicating the intrinsic height of the resource in CSS pixels, or 0 if no media is available yet

videoWidth.description: A value indicating the intrinsic width of the resource in CSS pixels, or 0 if no media is available yet

description: The video element is set up with a full‑HD resolution of 1920 × 1080 pixels, and it includes a poster image located at https://example.com/poster.jpg to display while the media is loading. Automatic picture‑in‑picture mode is enabled, so the player will enter or exit PiP when the user switches tabs or applications, and the feature is not disabled—users will be allowed to use picture‑in‑picture as needed.
